description: (Na)₂CoTlF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a CoTlF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the CoTlF₆ framework, Co is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form CoF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Co-F bond lengths are 1.87 Å. Tl is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form TlF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CoF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Tl-F bond lengths are 2.51 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Co and one Tl atom.
